# HEIC Local

> Convert HEIC photos to JPG or PNG in the browser. No upload, no signup, no watermark.

The public origin is https://heic-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

Canonical for every indexable page is the same URL on this origin. `/login` and `/api/auth` are noindex / Disallow.

## Tools

* [Convert HEIC](https://heic-local.vercel.app/) — Decode in this tab. JPG or PNG, batch ZIP.
* [Inspect ftyp](https://heic-local.vercel.app/info) — 64-byte header table. No JPG.

## Guides

* [How to convert](https://heic-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, JPG or PNG, ZIP.
* [Windows](https://heic-local.vercel.app/windows) — Explorer blank icon without a codec pack.
* [WhatsApp](https://heic-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Desktop “unsupported”.
* [iPhone](https://heic-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Safari, share sheet, in-app browsers.
* [FAQ](https://heic-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy and limits.
* [Use cases](https://heic-local.vercel.app/use-cases) — Portals that refuse HEIC.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API, no Live Photo unpack, and no `/blogs/` cluster.
